newsitem.title: USA: Procter & Gamble sets two for one stock split.
newsitem.headline: Procter & Gamble sets two for one stock split.

text.p: Procter & Gamble Co said Tuesday its board approved a two-for-one stock split in the form of a stock dividend effective August 22.
The company said the stock dividend will be made using shares already authorized by previous shareholder action.
Stock split shares will be mailed to shareholders on or after September 19.
The company said the two-for-one stock split will make its market price more accessible to individual investors, which should benefit shareholders by creating a broader market for its stock.
